저것.x: What building is that over there?
저것.e: 저 (that over there) + 것 (thing); in speech usually 저거.

맥주.x: Let's have a beer after work.
맥주.t: Pronounced [맥쭈]. 치맥 = chicken + beer, a popular combo.

축구.x: I play soccer with my friends on weekends.
축구.t: Ball sports use 하다: 축구를 하다 (play soccer). Pronounced [축꾸].

직원.ex: 이 회사에는 직원이 백 명쯤 있어요.
직원.x: This company has about a hundred employees.
직원.t: 직원 is any employee or staff member; 점원 is specifically a clerk in a shop.

놀이공원.x: On Children's Day, I went to an amusement park with the kids.

재활용.x: Plastic and paper can be recycled.
재활용.e: 재- = again, re-: 재활용, 재사용, 재시험.

궁궐.ex: 서울에는 경복궁 같은 아름다운 궁궐이 많아요.
궁궐.x: Seoul has many beautiful palaces, like Gyeongbokgung.
궁궐.t: Palace names end in -궁: 경복궁, 창덕궁, 덕수궁.

흙.x: The children are playing with dirt at the playground.
흙.t: Alone it's pronounced [흑], but 흙이 [흘기], 흙을 [흘글].

속도.ex: 비가 많이 오니까 속도를 좀 줄이세요.
속도.x: It's raining hard, so please slow down.
속도.t: Pronounced [속또] — the ㄷ tenses after ㄱ.

확신하다.m: to be convinced, to be sure, to be certain
확신하다.ex: 저는 우리 팀이 이길 거라고 확신해요.
확신하다.x: I'm sure our team will win.

중고 거래.m: secondhand trading, buying and selling used goods
중고 거래.ex: 안 쓰는 물건은 중고 거래로 팔아요.
중고 거래.x: I sell things I don't use through secondhand trading.
중고 거래.t: Mostly done on neighborhood apps, often as 직거래 (meeting in person); watch out for 사기 (scams) when paying in advance.

합의.ex: 두 회사는 오랜 회의 끝에 합의를 했어요.
합의.x: The two companies reached an agreement after a long meeting.
합의.t: Pronounced [하븨], and usually [하비] in everyday speech.

병균.ex: 손에는 눈에 보이지 않는 병균이 많아요.
병균.x: There are lots of invisible germs on your hands.
병균.t: 세균 is the general word for bacteria; 병균 stresses germs that cause disease.

독후감.x: I have to write a book report for vacation homework.
독후감.t: Pronounced [도쿠감] — ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

영감.x: The painter was inspired by the sea.
영감.t: Use 영감을 받다/얻다 'to get inspiration'; another word 영감 means 'old man' (casual).

농도.ex: 오늘은 미세먼지 농도가 높아서 마스크를 써야 해요.
농도.x: Fine-dust levels are high today, so you should wear a mask.

번거롭다.ex: 서류를 다시 내야 해서 좀 번거로워요.
번거롭다.x: It's a bit of a hassle because I have to submit the documents again.
번거롭다.t: Polite apology phrase: 번거롭게 해 드려서 죄송합니다 'Sorry for the trouble.'

확고하다.x: He's firmly determined to become a doctor.

입에 침이 마르다.forms: 입에 침이 마르도록 칭찬해요 · 입에 침이 마르게 자랑했어요 (르 irregular)
입에 침이 마르다.m: to praise to the skies, to rave about
입에 침이 마르다.ex: 선생님은 그 학생을 입에 침이 마르도록 칭찬하셨어요.
입에 침이 마르다.x: The teacher praised that student to the skies.
입에 침이 마르다.e: Literally 'to talk until your mouth runs dry of saliva.'
입에 침이 마르다.t: Almost always 입에 침이 마르도록 (or 마르게) + 칭찬하다/자랑하다.

효율성.ex: 새 프로그램 덕분에 업무 효율성이 높아졌어요.
효율성.x: Thanks to the new program, work efficiency has gone up.

식료품점.ex: 집 근처 식료품점에서 우유와 빵을 샀어요.
식료품점.x: I bought milk and bread at a grocery store near my house.
식료품점.t: Pronounced [싱뇨품점] by nasalization; in speech, 마트 is far more common.

욕구.ex: 사람은 누구나 인정받고 싶은 욕구가 있어요.
욕구.x: Everyone has a need to be recognized.
욕구.t: 욕구 is a basic need or urge; 욕망 suggests a stronger, often greedy desire.

시대착오.ex: 그런 생각은 이제 시대착오라고 할 수 있어요.
시대착오.x: That kind of thinking can now be called an anachronism.
시대착오.t: Most often as 시대착오적 'outdated': 시대착오적인 발상 'an outdated idea'.

핵무기.ex: 국제 사회는 핵무기 개발을 막기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.
핵무기.x: The international community is working to stop the development of nuclear weapons.
핵무기.t: Pronounced [행무기]: ㄱ before ㅁ becomes ㅇ (nasalization).

학술지.ex: 그 연구 결과는 유명한 국제 학술지에 실렸습니다.
학술지.x: The research findings were published in a famous international journal.
학술지.t: Pronounced [학쑬찌]; papers are 학술지에 실리다 'to be published in a journal'.

학구열.x: Korean parents' passion for education is world-famous.
학구열.t: Pronounced [학꾸열]; often describes parents' push for their children's schooling.

웅크리다.m: to crouch, to huddle, to curl up
웅크리다.ex: 고양이가 상자 안에서 몸을 웅크리고 자고 있어요.
웅크리다.x: The cat is sleeping curled up in a box.
웅크리다.e: Picture tucking everything in tight; the 'smaller-sounding' variant 옹크리다 means the same.

퍼붓다.forms: 퍼부어요 · 퍼부었어요 · 퍼부을 거예요 · 퍼부으세요 (ㅅ irregular)
퍼붓다.m: to pour down (of rain or snow); to shower (with insults or questions)
퍼붓다.ex: 갑자기 비가 퍼붓기 시작해서 옷이 다 젖었어요.
퍼붓다.x: It suddenly started pouring, and my clothes got soaked.
퍼붓다.e: 푸다 'to scoop' + 붓다 'to pour': scooping and dumping nonstop.
퍼붓다.t: Figurative: 욕을 퍼붓다 'to hurl insults', 질문을 퍼붓다 'to bombard with questions'.

빠듯하다.x: My salary is low, so money for living expenses is tight.
빠듯하다.t: Common with 시간, 예산, 일정: 일정이 빠듯해요 'The schedule is tight.'

절대적으로.ex: 이 일에는 여러분의 도움이 절대적으로 필요합니다.
절대적으로.x: Your help is absolutely necessary for this work.
절대적으로.t: 절대로 + negative means 'never'; 절대적으로 goes with positives like 필요하다 'absolutely necessary'.

정성껏.m: with care, with all one's heart, devotedly
정성껏.ex: 어머니가 손님을 위해 정성껏 음식을 준비하셨어요.
정성껏.x: My mother lovingly prepared food for the guests.
정성껏.e: -껏 = 'to the full extent of': 마음껏, 힘껏, 정성껏.

등잔 밑이 어둡다.forms: 등잔 밑이 어둡다더니 · 등잔 밑이 어둡다고
등잔 밑이 어둡다.m: it's hardest to see what's right under your nose
등잔 밑이 어둡다.ex: 등잔 밑이 어둡다더니 안경이 바로 책상 위에 있었어요.
등잔 밑이 어둡다.x: It's darkest under the lamp, as they say—my glasses were right on my desk.
등잔 밑이 어둡다.e: An oil lamp lights the room but leaves a shadow directly beneath itself.
등잔 밑이 어둡다.t: Pronounced [등잔 미치 어둡따]; -다더니 'as they say' is the usual way to quote a proverb.

합의금.x: The offender paid the victim settlement money and apologized.
합의금.e: 합의 'agreement' plus 금 'money' — money paid to settle a dispute.
합의금.t: Pronounced [하비금]; 합의를 보다 means 'to reach a settlement'.

주체적.x: We should help children think for themselves.

이해득실.m: pros and cons, gains and losses, what's in it for oneself
이해득실.x: He is someone who only ever calculates what's in it for him.

속죄.ex: 그는 평생 봉사하며 자신의 잘못을 속죄했어요.
속죄.x: He atoned for his wrongdoing by serving others his whole life.
속죄.e: Literally 'buying back a sin' — paying off a wrong.
속죄.t: Usually used as 속죄하다, often with 죄를 or 잘못을 as the object.

대구법.ex: '산은 높고 물은 깊다'는 대구법을 활용한 문장이에요.
대구법.x: 'The mountains are high and the waters deep' is a sentence using parallelism.
대구법.e: Literally 'paired-phrase method' — matching phrases set side by side.

곡선미.x: Hanok roofs are beautiful for their soft curves.
곡선미.t: Said of a person, it praises body shape, so use it carefully outside art contexts.

답지하다.m: to pour in, to flood in (letters, donations, aid)
답지하다.ex: 수재민을 돕기 위한 성금이 전국에서 답지했습니다.
답지하다.x: Donations to help flood victims poured in from across the country.
답지하다.t: Pronounced [답찌하다]. Subjects are things arriving: 성금, 편지, 문의, 격려.

적시하다.m: to point out, to specify, to state explicitly
적시하다.x: The report specifically pointed out the cause of the problem.
적시하다.e: Literally 'pick out and show' — naming a fact clearly.
적시하다.t: Legal term 사실 적시 명예훼손 means defamation by stating facts; don't confuse with 적시 適時 'timely'.
